visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair styled in a ponytail, wearing a black athletic polo shirt with yellow stripes and the word 'FELICITY,' stands in a modern electronics store. She smiles broadly at the camera, framing her face with her hands in a playful gesture. Shelves of boxed gaming products are visible in the background. (2) The woman stands in front of a sleek dark wall featuring a large, glowing light-blue Logitech G logo. She points both hands towards the logo and a display of boxed Logitech G racing peripherals. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean retail environment. (3) The scene transitions to the woman seated inside a high-end racing simulator. She is positioned in a red and black bucket seat, holding a professional-grade gaming steering wheel. She looks focused yet excited, moving the wheel as if navigating a track, with her face showing intense engagement. (4) A wide shot reveals the full racing simulator setup, including a large curved monitor displaying the cockpit view of a racing game on a sunny track. A laptop sits on a stand to the right. The woman’s back is to the camera as she actively participates in the virtual race. (5) The woman points at a digital leaderboard displayed on a monitor, which lists her as 5th place in a ranking. She reacts with an exaggerated expression of surprise, mouth slightly open and eyes wide, while pointing to her name on the list of competitors. (6) She holds up a clear plastic bag containing promotional items for the G Challenge event. She pulls out a black keychain that reads 'KEEP PLAYING' in white text and a branded voucher card, showing them close to the camera lens to ensure the details are visible. (7) A series of graphic-heavy informational slides appear, detailing the 'Logitech G x McLaren G Challenge' event dates and rules. These slides feature high-quality renders of McLaren racing cars, large QR codes for registration, and colorful text overlays against a dark, tech-themed background.
